name: Simon
brief: One of the "brethren of the Lord" (a kinsman of Jesus)
short: Simon is named among the brethren of the Lord. Scripture calls him one of the Lord's "brothers" (Matt 13:55), a word used for kinsmen; the Church holds that Mary remained ever-virgin and bore no other children. St Jerome took the brethren to be cousins, sons of Mary the wife of Clopas; Eastern tradition holds them sons of Joseph by an earlier marriage.
